data: What is the average morphological complexity of the topmost bar?

The topmost bar represents the "3rd ps sg s" morph. The x-axis of the chart indicates the average morphological complexity, ranging from 0.000 to 0.004. The length of the bar corresponds to its value on this scale. By visually inspecting the chart, the topmost bar appears to extend approximately to 0.004 on the x-axis. Therefore, the average morphological complexity of the topmost bar is approximately 0.004.
